name: What permits are required for a whole house remodel in Irvine?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a whole house remodel in Irvine?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Irvine, a whole house remodel typically requires various permits from the city's building department. These often include general building permits for structural changes, and specific permits for electrical, plumbing, and mechanical work. Depending on the scope, you might also need permits for grading, flood plain development, or historic preservation. Your contractor will usually handle permit applications, ensuring all work complies with local codes and regulations before starting the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Irvine, whole house remodels require general building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits, managed by your contractor.
